title: Rotary Lobe Pump

introduction.definition: A rotary lobe pump has two lobed rotors that turn in opposite directions without touching, driven and timed by external timing gears. Liquid is carried around the outside of each rotor between the lobes and the casing; large cavities and gentle action make it ideal for hygienic and solids-laden products.

classification.configuration: Rotary lobe, external timing gears, overhung rotors

introduction.summary: Two lobed rotors turn in opposite directions inside a close-fitting case. They never touch each other or the case — timing gears in the gearbox keep them in phase — so the pump is gentle on shear-sensitive and particle-laden products and can run dry briefly. As the lobes separate at the inlet a void forms and fills; the liquid is carried around the outside of each rotor and expelled where the lobes re-mesh at the outlet. Widely used in food, beverage, pharmaceutical and wastewater sludge service; easy to clean in place.

piping: Size the suction line for low velocity (viscous liquids need large suction pipes); provide a strainer.
Fit a pressure-relief valve (integral or in the discharge line) — a positive-displacement pump will build pressure until something breaks if the discharge is blocked.
Support piping independently of the pump.
commissioning: Never start against a closed discharge valve.
Fill the pump with liquid (or ensure the suction is flooded) before start — avoid dry running unless the design allows it.

script.narration: This module introduces the Rotary Lobe Pump.
A rotary lobe pump has two lobed rotors that turn in opposite directions without touching, driven and timed by external timing gears.
Liquid is carried around the outside of each rotor between the lobes and the casing; large cavities and gentle action make it ideal for hygienic and solids-laden products.
Typical applications include food, beverage and dairy (hygienic, CIP/SIP); pharmaceutical; wastewater sludge; paint, polymers and pulp.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Rotor Case (Pump Chamber), Front Cover (Quick-Release), Drive Rotor & Shaft, Driven Rotor & Shaft.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Rotary Lobe Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Rotary Lobe Pump.
Check seals and gearbox oil level.
Change gearbox oil.
Check rotor clearances and timing.
Watch for rotor contact: knocking, metal in product. Common cause: timing gear or bearing wear.
Watch for seal leakage: product at the seal. Common cause: dry running seals.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
